arStrings.szText: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.

When an enemy is afflicted by both a {c_important}Hex{/c} and an {c_important}Aura{/c} Effect, a {c_important}Piranhado{/c} is summoned pulling enemies towards it and dealing {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} Physical damage over {c_random}[SF_3|1|]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_2} {c_important}Piranhado{/c} will move itself towards nearby enemies.{/if} May occur once every {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds.
